name: Deck & Defense
detailed_description:
Where Strategy Flows Like Magic

Deck&Defense is a fast-paced real-time deckbuilder that merges roguelite progression with strategic tower defense in a fantasy world. Guard the mountain pass against endless waves of enemies using a dynamic card system that evolves with every run.

REAL-TIME DECKBUILDING COMBAT

Make split-second decisions as you draw, play, and strategize in fluid real-time battles. No turn-based waiting—your reflexes and tactical thinking are equally important as you deploy cards to defend the pass.

ENDLESS CARD COMBINATIONS

  • Summon powerful allies to fight alongside you

  • Cast devastating spells to control the battlefield

  • Upgrade and enhance defensive towers

  • Fuse cards to create unique and powerful effects

  • Discover synergies that unlock game-changing combos

ROGUELITE PROGRESSION

Each run through the mountain pass strengthens your arsenal. Purchase new cards, unlock permanent upgrades, and refine your strategy with every attempt. Death is not the end—it's an opportunity to return stronger.

MULTIPLE PLAYSTYLES

Master different approaches to defense:

  • Tower Commander: Focus on building and upgrading defensive structures

  • Summoner: Control the battlefield with an army of conjured allies

  • Spellcaster: Unleash elemental chaos with direct damage and area control

  • Hybrid Tactician: Blend styles for versatile strategies that adapt to any threat

CHALLENGING PROGRESSION

Face increasingly difficult waves of diverse enemies, from wild animals to legendary beasts, each requiring different tactics to overcome. Adapt your deck and strategy as you progress through challenging stages. 

Dive into the creation of never-before-seen combo chains! Will you discover the most devastating card synergies and unleash destruction upon your enemies like no one has before?

short_description: A real-time deckbuilder roguelite where strategy meets action. Summon allies, cast devastating spells, and upgrade towers as you build powerful card combinations to repel waves of enemies in this unique fantasy defense experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100 or equivalent
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400F / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or equivalent
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
